description: 🚀 We are AXIOM4, a passionate team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our project focuses on developing a software-based Astronaut Health Monitoring System to monitor astronaut health, analyze health data, identify potential risks, and support well-being during space missions. We aim to combine AI, software development, and innovative problem-solving to contribute to safer space exploration! 🛰️
summary:
ASTRA-CARE (Astronaut Space Telemetry & Risk Assessment) is an offline-first autonomous health monitoring and clinical decision-support platform designed for astronauts on long-duration exploration missions.

Addressing the challenge of deep space medical autonomy, ASTRA-CARE provides 11 operational modules—including real-time vital signs, an anatomical digital twin, exercise countermeasure tracking, mental wellness screening, autonomous emergency protocols, and live NASA DONKI space-weather alerts. Built upon NASA’s RIDGE framework (Radiation, Isolation, Distance, Gravity, Environment), the system pairs continuous biometric telemetry with an explainable, deterministic AI risk engine to detect early physiological decompensation against personal baselines.

This is critical because interplanetary missions to Mars encounter communication latencies of up to 22 minutes, preventing real-time telemedicine from Earth flight surgeons. Operating with zero cloud dependencies, ASTRA-CARE ensures complete medical autonomy for deep space crews while offering dual-use diagnostic capabilities for remote, isolated communities on Earth.
details:
ASTRA-CARE

Team Axiom4 | NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

1. What does it do and how does it work?

ASTRA-CARE (Astronaut Space Telemetry & Risk Assessment - Clinical Autonomous Response Engine) is an offline-first, explainable clinical decision-support and health monitoring platform designed for astronauts on long-duration exploration missions (such as Artemis lunar missions and future deep space transit to Mars).

At Mars distances, radio signals take up to 22 minutes each way, ruling out real-time telemedicine from flight surgeons on Earth. ASTRA-CARE bridges this critical operational gap through 11 integrated software modules:

  • Vital Signs & Digital Twin: Continuously monitors cardiovascular rhythms, SpO₂ saturation, core temperature, and hemodynamic cephalic fluid shifts through an interactive, anatomical digital twin.
  • Physical Health & Countermeasure Tracking: Monitors crew compliance with NASA's prescribed daily resistive (ARED) and cycle ergometer (CEVIS) exercise targets (900 min/week).
  • Mental Wellness & Sleep Hygiene: Tracks circadian rhythm alignment, sleep architecture, cognitive fatigue, and psychological stress markers.
  • Radiation Monitor (Live NASA DONKI Integration): Ingests real-time heliospheric space-weather telemetry (solar flares, coronal mass ejections, geomagnetic storms) from NASA’s Space Weather Modeling Center, strictly distinguishing external ambient space weather from personal biological absorbed dose (ALARA standard).
  • Explainable AI Risk Engine: A deterministic, rule-based risk evaluation system that compares multi-modal vital telemetry against personal astronaut baselines to detect early signs of decompensation (such as SANS or cardiovascular deconditioning) with transparent, human-readable explanations.
  • Autonomous Emergency Protocols: Interactive operational emergency checklists (e.g., toxic atmosphere cabin leaks, anaphylaxis, cardiac arrest) featuring rapid step-by-step guidance and incident reporting.
  • Asynchronous Telemedicine & Local PDF Export: Compiles client-side clinical health summaries into downloadable PDFs for transmission to Earth ground control during scheduled communication windows.
  • Space Science & Research Repository: Formally organizes the underlying biomedical evidence base from the NASA Human Research Program (HRP) and the Canadian Space Agency (CSA).

2. What benefits does it have?

  • Overcomes Telemedicine Latency: Enables crews to autonomously detect, triage, and manage acute medical emergencies and chronic microgravity adaptation without waiting for Earth-based medical advice.
  • Prevents Diagnostic "Black-Box" Errors: Unlike speculative generative models that can hallucinate medical recommendations, ASTRA-CARE uses deterministic, rule-based clinical scoring algorithms with full clinical explainability and countermeasure justifications.
  • Decoupled Data Architecture: Enforces strict scientific boundaries—space-weather solar alerts are never conflated with personal dosimeter readings, and bone mineral density is never falsely inferred from exercise time alone.
  • Zero Cloud Dependency: The entire system runs 100% locally in the browser with localStorage persistence, functioning reliably through spacecraft communications blackouts.

3. What is the intended impact?

  • Deep Space Exploration: Safeguards crew health, prevents mission-compromising medical emergencies, and enhances mission survivability on extended lunar surface stays and multi-year Mars expeditions.
  • Dual-Use Terrestrial Impact (Earth Benefit): The decentralized, offline-first triage architecture directly translates to remote, rural, and extreme terrestrial environments—including Arctic research stations, maritime vessels, search-and-rescue teams, and underserved rural clinics that lack direct access to specialized medical infrastructure.

4. What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software were used?

  • Frontend Architecture: React 19, TypeScript, and Vite 8.3 for type-safe, ultra-fast modular client development.
  • UI & Aerospace Design System: Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide React icons, and custom aerospace dark-mode styling optimized for low-glare, high-stress habitat environments.
  • Data Visualization: Recharts for responsive real-time biometric telemetry, dosimeter curves, and multi-axis trend charting.
  • Document Compilation & Security: jsPDF and html2canvas for browser-based offline medical reporting; DOMPurify for sanitizing incoming live API payloads.
  • Live Space Data Integration: NASA Space Weather Database of Notifications, Knowledge, and Information (DONKI) REST API with dynamic rolling 30-day queries and graceful offline fallbacks.
  • Quality Assurance & Verification: Comprehensive automated test suite (179 automated tests verifying state transitions, astronaut profile switching, route integrity, and error boundaries).
  • Target Hardware: Standard crew tablets, spacecraft laptops, and habitat workstation consoles.

5. How is your project creative?

  • Interactive Operational RIDGE Mapping: Rather than treating NASA's five hazards of human spaceflight (Radiation, Isolation, Distance, Gravity, Environment) as static reference text, ASTRA-CARE directly operationalizes each hazard into interactive software tools (Radiation Monitor, Mental Wellness, Emergency Latency Checklists, Physical Health Countermeasures, and Habitat Atmospheric Isolation).
  • Multi-Scenario Simulation Engine: Features built-in simulation scenarios (Nominal, Deteriorating, and Recovering) that dynamically update all telemetry charts, risk flags, and clinical recommendations, allowing flight surgeons and crew to conduct interactive emergency preparedness drills.
  • Human-Centered Aerospace Ergonomics: High-contrast color-coded alert badges (Nominal, Caution, Warning, Critical) and intuitive touch controls designed to minimize cognitive load during high-stress operational anomalies.

6. What factors did your team consider?

  • Medical & Scientific Integrity: Adherence to NASA HRP standards (career dose ceilings, SANS risk monitoring, cardiovascular fluid-shift protocols) and CSA radioprotection guidelines. A clear student research prototype disclaimer is displayed, ensuring that this tool is recognized as an uncertified research prototype and decision-support tool.
  • Bandwidth & Communications Reality: Designed from the ground up for zero-bandwidth deep space environments, ensuring full functionality with or without internet connectivity.
  • Data Privacy & Mission Integrity: Zero tracking, zero telemetry leakage, and strict client-side data isolation.
